title: Cinema, Narrative and Modernity
description: Explores influential movements, styles and experiments in cinema across different periods and regions. Focuses on how filmmakers respond to political, cultural and aesthetic change through innovation in narrative, image and sound. Examines modernisms, revolutionary cinema, postcolonial film and transnational stylistic developments, with an emphasis on film movements as artistic and historical responses to modernity.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ENSH 328, ENSH 323 (if taken in the same topic).
